notes: Zones from the City of Chandler's ChandlerFlexServiceArea shapefile, emailed 2026-11-16 (8 polygons, State Plane Arizona Central feet, reprojected to WGS84 with mapshaper; pieces snapped within 20 ft and dissolved, and a zero-width slit the dissolve left along the old south edge removed). Ryan picked (CIV-1753): the current area plus Expansion Zone 1.B now, then the 2027 area from its start date, switched by date (validUntil/validFrom) with no republish. 'Southwest Chandler' = Original Service Area Core (2022-2024) + 2024 Expansion + Expansion Zone 1.B - 2026, dissolved; it runs until 2026-12-31. 'Southwest Chandler, 2027 area' = Original Service Area Core + 2024 Expansion + 2027 Expansion Zone (which contains 1.B), dissolved; it starts 2027-01-01. The 2027 start date is assumed: the file says only 'Service Area (2027-)' and the City page gives no date; confirm with Chandler. Left out: '2024 Expansion - Student Only' (inside both the City's 'Service Area (2024-2026)' and 'Service Area (2027-)' polygons, so those two were not used as given; eligibility-limited areas are never drawn), and '2027 Expansion Zone 2 - (Not approved)'. Hours, fares, booking and pickup ('virtual bus stop' at a nearby corner; door-to-door for wheelchair riders) from the City page, 2026-11-16. Weekend days are set to no service because the page lists Monday to Friday only. Run by Via under a City contract through 2027-06-30.
